description: A modular, bring-your-own-resource version of the Microsoft Discovery stack. Independent Bicep modules for networking, identity, storage, RBAC, Supercomputer, Workspace, and Project let you integrate Discovery into an existing landing zone by reusing your own virtual network, managed identity, storage account, or user groups.
summary: Modular Microsoft Discovery deployment with independent modules and bring-your-own network, identity, and storage.
